services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Host your next event in a facility unique to Wickenburg, where you’ll be surrounded by the Old West, the New West, and the Next West. From business meetings to large celebrations, think of us when planning your next memorable occasion. The Museum galleries are ideal for cocktail receptions and small gatherings. Our Cultural Crossroads Learning Center can transform for any event, from a gala dinner or a symposium or lecture, with an open floor plan and recently updated a/v equipment. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Fill out this short form before viewing the 10 minute educational video that was produced in 2020. Embark on a genuine adventure at Sigler Western Museum in Wickenburg, Arizona, where world class art collections meet historical exhibitions. Sigler Western Museum’s exhibitions and free guidePORT audio tours tell the fascinating stories of explorers, cowboys, miners, and others who lived and worked in the American West. Sigler Western Museum field trips are always free for groups age 17 and under.
